    4 class Battle::Peer
    5   def pbStorePokemon(player, pkmn)
    6     if !player.party_full?
    7       player.party[player.party.length] = pkmn
    8       return -1
    9     end
   10     if Settings::HEAL_STORED_POKEMON
   11       old_ready_evo = pkmn.ready_to_evolve
   12       pkmn.heal
   13       pkmn.ready_to_evolve = old_ready_evo
   14     end
   15     oldCurBox = pbCurrentBox
   16     storedBox = $PokemonStorage.pbStoreCaught(pkmn)
   17     if storedBox < 0
   18       # NOTE: Poké Balls can't be used if storage is full, so you shouldn't ever
   19       #       see this message.
   20       pbDisplayPaused(_INTL("Can't catch any more..."))
   21       return oldCurBox
   22     end
   23     return storedBox
   24   end
   25 
   26   def pbGetStorageCreatorName
   27     return pbGetStorageCreator if $player.seen_storage_creator
   28     return nil
   29   end
   30 
   31   def pbCurrentBox
   32     return $PokemonStorage.currentBox
   33   end
   34 
   35   def pbBoxName(box)
   36     return (box < 0) ? "" : $PokemonStorage[box].name
   37   end
   38 
   39   def pbOnStartingBattle(battle, pkmn, wild = false)
   40     f = MultipleForms.call("getFormOnStartingBattle", pkmn, wild)
   41     pkmn.form = f if f
   42     MultipleForms.call("changePokemonOnStartingBattle", pkmn, battle)
   43   end
   44 
   45   def pbOnEnteringBattle(battle, battler, pkmn, wild = false)
   46     f = MultipleForms.call("getFormOnEnteringBattle", pkmn, wild)
   47     pkmn.form = f if f
   48     battler.form = pkmn.form if battler.form != pkmn.form
   49     MultipleForms.call("changePokemonOnEnteringBattle", battler, pkmn, battle)
   50   end
   51 
   52   # For switching out, including due to fainting, and for the end of battle
   53   def pbOnLeavingBattle(battle, pkmn, usedInBattle, endBattle = false)
   54     return if !pkmn
   55     f = MultipleForms.call("getFormOnLeavingBattle", pkmn, battle, usedInBattle, endBattle)
   56     pkmn.form = f if f && pkmn.form != f
   57     pkmn.hp = pkmn.totalhp if pkmn.hp > pkmn.totalhp
   58     MultipleForms.call("changePokemonOnLeavingBattle", pkmn, battle, usedInBattle, endBattle)
   59   end
   60 end
